summary: This is a routine 8-K reporting results of T1 Energy Inc.'s 2026 annual meeting of stockholders. Matters voted include director elections, ratification of auditor KPMG LLP, advisory say-on-pay, and approval of a charter amendment to double authorized common shares from 500M to 1B. No merger, tender offer, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special situation is involved. The charter amendment is a standard capital-authorization increase, not a rights offering or capital return. Accordingly, this filing does not constitute a special-situation event.
